name: Data Grid Improvements in Data Warehouse & SQL Endpoint - Milestone 2
description: The Data Grid feature for data warehouses and SQL analytics endpoints includes:* Data Handling: Supports large datasets with virtualization for performance.* Column & Row Features: Reorder, hide/show, group, pin, define dynamic columns, sort, filter, and select multiple rows.* Filtering & Sorting: Multi-column sorting and custom filters for data types (string, integer, date).* Search: Search across columns.* Grid-Level Options: Copy data with/without headers, select multiple rows, and export data in various formats.
